''See also: [[Yerin Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin, also known as Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] or the [[Death]] [[Monarch]] Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]], is a formidable [[sacred artist]] and a prodigy of the [[Path of the Endless Sword]]. A disciple of both a [[Sage]] and an [[Underlord]], she is characterized by her intense combat prowess, scarred appearance, and straight-cut black hair. She possesses a unique ability to manifest a [[Blood Shadow]] and has achieved significant milestones, including the manifestation of the [[Death Icon]] during her [[advancement]] to [[Monarch]]. Her combat style is defined by mastery over [[sword aura]] and the use of specialized weapons, such as her white-bladed sword and silver [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] that emerge from her back. Though she was originally a disciple of the [[Sword Sage]], Yerin was later adopted into the prestigious [[Arelius family]] by [[Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius]]. Throughout her journey, she has demonstrated immense resilience, surviving battles against [[Remnants]], high-level [[dragons]], and even [[Monarchs]]. Her role often involves protecting her companion, [[Lindon{{!}}Wei Shi Lindon]], and she has been known to act as a protector for various groups, such as the cult of the [[Bleeding Phoenix]]. Driven by a philosophy that embraces challenge and death as natural elements of existence, Yerin has transitioned from a ragged warrior to a powerful [[Monarch]] capable of influencing the [[Fate{{!}}fate]] of worlds.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin is a woman with black hair that hangs past her shoulders, featuring a red streak and occasionally shining red. She has eyes that blaze red like [[Fury]]'s and wears various outfits including white [[Heaven's Glory]] clothes, tattered black clothing with a stolen [[Iron{{!}}iron]] badge, and formal layers of black, violet, and silver. Her [[Goldsign]] consists of a pair of silver arms that flatten into sword-blades, and she can manifest up to six gleaming metallic red or silver sword-arms from her back.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin is driven by a rage that is stronger than her fear and possesses an overwhelming offensive power. She is a protective companion who refuses to leave [[Lindon]] behind, though she has expressed jealousy toward [[Mercy]] and fury regarding [[Northstrider]]. She is a highly skilled combatant who remains focused on her goal to become a [[Sword Sage]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Yerin is the adopted sister of [[Eithan]] and an adopted member of the [[Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius]] clan. She is a disciple of the [[Sword Sage]], whose [[Remnant]] she intends to harvest, and she travels with her companion [[Lindon]]. Her connections include being a student or subordinate to [[Timaias Adama]], a person of interest to [[Red Faith]], and a companion to [[Mercy]], [[Orthos]], and [[Ruby]], who is her [[Blood Shadow]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[sacred artist]] following the [[Path of the Endless Sword]], Yerin utilizes silver aura and various techniques such as the [[Flowing Sword]], [[Moonlight Bridge]], [[Phoenix Song]], and [[Shadow]]. She possesses an [[Iron body]], a powerful [[spirit-sense{{!}}spiritual sense]], and can manifest multiple sword-arms from her back using her [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]]. Her combat repertoire also includes the [[Endless Sword]] technique, [[black-and-white Striker techniques]], and the use of a [[void key]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Disciple of the Sword Sage}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|As a disciple of the [[Sword Sage]], Yerin follows the [[Path of the Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c11">''Unsouled'', chapter 11</ref> She is a warrior characterized by blade-straight hair, shredded black robes, and a network of scars stretching from her fingertips to her wrists.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c16">''Unsouled'', chapter 16</ref> While her boundary is not particularly powerful and requires little energy to operate, she believes that a [[sacred artist]] must shed blood when the time is right.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17">''Unsouled'', chapter 17</ref> Born a [[Ruler]], she intends to harvest the [[Remnant]] of her master, who was an expert without peer.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" /> Yerin has forged a flat shimmer in the air that resembles a sword hammered from pure force.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" /> She can utilize [[sword madra]] to break [[scripts]] and has used her sword to fight a [[Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c18">''Unsouled'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c19">''Unsouled'', chapter 19</ref> While traveling on a rosy cloud toward the [[Ancestor's Tomb]], she employs the [[Endless Sword]] technique.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c19" /> Her appearance includes a [[steel]] limb on her back resembling one of the six blades on the [[Remnant of the Sword Sage{{!}}Sword Sage's Remnant]], as well as a [[gold badge]] featuring a simple sword image worn around her neck.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c20">''Unsouled'', chapter 20</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Sacred Valley}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Before reaching the age of ten, Yerin was at the [[Iron stage]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c1">''Soulsmith'', chapter 1</ref> She eventually became a legendary [[Gold stage]] [[sacred artist]] and a skilled [[Enforcer]] who served as [[Lindon]]'s teacher.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c2">''Soulsmith'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c3">''Soulsmith'', chapter 3</ref> As a [[Lowgold]] practitioner and the strongest being in [[Sacred Valley]] by a significant margin, she possessed a white blade and a silver sword-arm on her back.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c3" /> The disciple of a [[Sage]], who belongs to no clan, possesses a pure and clean spirit.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c6">''Soulsmith'', chapter 6</ref> While traveling with [[Lindon]], she carries a sheathed sword and wears a blood-[[red rope]] around her waist.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c5">''Soulsmith'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c6" /> Yerin can gather [[sword madra]] from her surroundings and possesses overwhelming offensive power.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9">''Soulsmith'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13">''Soulsmith'', chapter 13</ref> Associated with [[Fisher Gesha]], she was granted guest rooms within the main sect and spent her time hunting [[sacred beasts]] and [[Remnants]] while wearing a black robe provided by the [[Fishers]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c11">''Soulsmith'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12">''Soulsmith'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Yerin, a miner who wears a collar and possesses a bladed arm on her back, drew her white sword against [[Sandviper Kral{{!}}Kral]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14">''Soulsmith'', chapter 14</ref> While questioning [[Eithan]]'s identity, she protested that [[Lindon]] was not sturdy.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" /> A peak [[Jade stage]] practitioner with a flawless foundation, Yerin utilizes [[sword madra]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref> Her voice could be heard through the door as she looked at [[Lindon]] with pity, noting that she was only halfway through pushing [[madra channels]] through her entire body.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16">''Soulsmith'', chapter 16</ref> After fighting almost without rest for a full night and most of the following day, she was left by [[Eithan]] to watch over [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c16" /> As a combatant running with [[Lindon]], she used a twisted seashell [[binding]] to spray water and saw her [[Goldsign]] flash during a [[Remnant]] attack.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c17">''Soulsmith'', chapter 17</ref> During the confrontation with [[Sandviper Kral{{!}}Kral]], she unleashed a wave of [[sword madra]] against [[Jai Long]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c18">''Soulsmith'', chapter 18</ref> Despite being outclassed in power by [[Jai Long]], Yerin displayed high skill and possesses a bladed [[Goldsign]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20">''Soulsmith'', chapter 20</ref> She has not risen from where she fell, and her weightless body drifted on the breeze as she remembered her master's teaching that no [[Path]] is wide enough for two.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19">''Soulsmith'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Skysworn application}} ===

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|While held in [[chains]] and shackles, Yerin displayed [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] consisting of [[Forged]] [[silver madra]] blades and two blade-ended arms extending from her back.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref> Her [[Blood Shadow]] is a mass of living [[blood madra]] that forms a copy of her.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4">''Ghostwater'', chapter 4</ref> After passing through a [[Jade{{!}}jade]] doorway sword-first, she utilized the [[Rippling Sword Striker]] technique.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c4" /> Refusing to leave [[Lindon]] behind, she attempted to reach a [[portal]] to save him.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c5">''Ghostwater'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref> Despite having an empty core, Yerin met with the [[Sage]] and taught [[Lindon]] principles of combat.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7">''Ghostwater'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10">''Ghostwater'', chapter 10</ref> Her [[Path]] is the [[Path of the Endless Sword]], featuring === {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Skysworn cloudship pilot}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Yerin serves as a pilot for the [[Skysworn cloudship]] and utilizes three blades in combat.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c2">''Underlord'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3">''Underlord'', chapter 3</ref> A practitioner of the [[sacred arts]] who possesses [[soulfire]], she can slash [[acidic madra]] from the air and uses pulses of tightly controlled [[sword madra]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19">''Underlord'', chapter 19</ref> Her silver [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] can be withdrawn into her back, where she can manifest six arms of [[sword madra]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8">''Underlord'', chapter 8</ref> During a race to reach the end of [[Truegold]], she beat [[Lindon]] by ten seconds.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /> Clad in [[Skysworn armor]], she fights with seamless movement and the ability to [[veil]] her [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c18">''Underlord'', chapter 18</ref> Despite her combat prowess, Yerin's lifeline is severely damaged and she enters a dying state that requires [[Brightcrown]] healers.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12">''Underlord'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14">''Underlord'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15">''Underlord'', chapter 15</ref> To survive and achieve her goal of becoming an [[Underlady]], she would need her [[soulfire]] to rebuild her lifeline.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c15" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Uncrowned King tournament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|While competing in the [[Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned King tournament]], Yerin utilizes six gleaming sword-arms and [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] that sweep like claws.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2">''Uncrowned'', chapter 2</ref> Her [[sword aura{{!}}sword-aura]] can detonate into the [[Endless Sword]], and she also employs the [[Shadow]] technique.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4">''Uncrowned'', chapter 4</ref> Although she is not an [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] by birth, Yerin was adopted into the family and later spoke through a [[transmission construct]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c6">''Uncrowned'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8">''Uncrowned'', chapter 8</ref> She communicates with [[Lindon]] via a jewel-[[construct]] and uses a blindfold to focus her perception, as she can only feel [[madra]] rather than seeing without her eyes.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c7">''Uncrowned'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8" /> Yerin's purple crystalline [[construct]] utilizes dream and [[shadow madra]], and she was once a [[Highgold]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c8" /> Ranked eleventh in the tournament, she is an adopted member of [[Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius]] who took a crown during the competition.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12">''Uncrowned'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref> During combat, she has used the [[Endless Sword]] to cover [[Naru Saeya]] and utilized [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] to create a cage.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13">''Uncrowned'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c18">''Uncrowned'', chapter 18</ref> A chosen of [[Akura Malice]] from the [[Blackflame Empire]], Yerin is the only person physically stronger than [[Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c18" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Dressed in a [[sacred artist's robe]] identical to the one [[Lindon]] previously observed, Yerin has progressed to the [[Underlord]] stage and possesses [[Diamond Veins]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref> She feels intense fury toward [[Northstrider]] for forcing a confrontation between her and [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20">''Uncrowned'', chapter 20</ref> During the battle, Yerin utilizes a crimson spiritual copy of herself known as a [[Blood Shadow]] to observe her opponent and fight alongside her.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20" /> Although her body trembles with the effort of combat, she wields a version of the [[Final Sword]] through her [[Blood Shadow]] and ultimately wins her fight against [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c21">''Uncrowned'', chapter 21</ref> Yerin is frequently mobbed by strangers.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c21" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Yerin is the apprentice and subordinate of [[Timaias Adama]], having departed alongside him.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c1">''Wintersteel'', chapter 1</ref> As a [[Jade]] with a parasite in her soul, she possesses power on the level of an [[Archlord]] and is a potential future [[Sage of the Endless Sword]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c1" /> A fighter associated with [[Malice]], she remains active in the competition and utilizes a gem-like [[dream tablets{{!}}dream tablet]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c2">''Wintersteel'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref> While accompanying [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]], she observed a fight from the [[Akura audience platform]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4">''Wintersteel'', chapter 4</ref> Despite a false announcement that she would fight [[Mercy]], Yerin is instead scheduled for a month of training with a [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref> Dressed in formal layers of black, violet, and silver, she possesses powers similar to [[Blacksword]] and watches the [[Uncrowned]] matches alongside [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Pupil of the Winter Sage}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Although [[Red Faith]] expressed a desire to tutor her, Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] was instead chosen as a pupil by the [[Winter Sage]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> Clad in a standard black uniform, Yerin has cultivated her [[Blood Shadow]] using a technique from the [[Blood Sage]] and once experienced swirling nine-colored light while her eyes were closed.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" /> After gathering with [[Mercy]] and [[Eithan]] at the end of a [[cloudship]] dock, Yerin stayed in a network of wooden huts where her outer robe was shredded by icy winds.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref> Despite having an adequate foundation and training to sense [[sword aura]] in the freezing cold, her [[Forger technique]] remains brittle and weak.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /> The heir to the [[Endless Sword]] utilizes [[spirit-sense{{!}}spiritual sense]] and the [[Hidden Sword]] technique to fight.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" /> Following a near-fatal encounter with [[Riyusai Meira{{!}}Meira]], Yerin fought a demon in a snowy village while being aware that a [[Monarch-killing weapon]] was at stake.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c10">''Wintersteel'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11">''Wintersteel'', chapter 11</ref> While [[Eithan]] can funnel [[advancement]] resources to her, Yerin hoped he had permission for his actions.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c11" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15">''Wintersteel'', chapter 15</ref> During a battle with [[Lindon]], Yerin used her sword and calming breaths to maintain her [[madra]] flow, which caused her sword to glow silver.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12">''Wintersteel'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17">''Wintersteel'', chapter 17</ref> As the sole remaining participant in the tournament, Yerin's spirits lifted when the [[Ninecloud Soul]] manifested and announced her as the winner.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|As a potential participant in the tournament, Yerin fell toward [[Lindon]] with her sword raised.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18">''Wintersteel'', chapter name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c19">''Wintersteel'', chapter 19</ref> After interrupting and insulting the [[Blood Sage]], she witnessed mirror images of her own memories and observed her own serene === {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Wei clan}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|While at the [[Wei clan]], Yerin stood upon the bough of a giant tree.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c13" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c14">''Bloodline'', chapter 14</ref> She previously escaped her own pursuit by school pursuers in the wild territory.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15">''Bloodline'', chapter 15</ref> Possessing the [[Broken Crown]], her [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] moved erratically while her eyes glowed red like [[scripts]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16">''Bloodline'', chapter 16</ref> Yerin noted that [[Lindon]] is someone who does not give up and would not abandon her even if her core popped and she became no better than a [[Copper]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c16" /> After her [[Divine Treasure]] failed to recover in time, she felt useless following the loss of her spine and briefly experienced having two minds in her head.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17">''Bloodline'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref> An outsider to [[Lindon]]'s home, she saw herself caught by the tail of the [[Wandering Titan]] in a vision.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18" /> Yerin dashed out of a blue-edged crack in space to focus the [[Final Sword]] through her blade as the [[Dreadgod]] moved toward her.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19">''Bloodline'', chapter 19</ref> Her body was eventually covered in veins of bright [[Red madra{{!}}red madra]] that replaced her broken flesh.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21">''Bloodline'', chapter 21</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|While questioning the anchor, Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] was the individual expected to drive off the [[Dreadgod]], a presence that [[Malice]] could feel.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c2">''Reaper'', chapter 2</ref> After [[Lindon]] brought her to the [[Sword Sage’s void space]], Yerin paused at the entrance of the [[Tomb]] where she had previously fought her master's [[Remnant]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c3">''Reaper'', chapter 3</ref> The [[Uncrowned Queen]], who is considered a hero of the [[Blackflame Empire]], can be seen playing darts with sharpened blades of grass.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c5">''Reaper'', chapter 5</ref> A person of interest to [[Red Faith]], Yerin possesses dream techniques and can be tracked using [[spiritual perception]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7">''Reaper'', chapter 7</ref> She also harbored hatred for [[The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix]] and her [[Blood Shadow]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Yerin is an individual for whom [[Lindon]] intends to create both an echo and a complex [[construct]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2">''Dreadgod'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> She appeared in a flash of [[white light]] upon the deck of a ship at sea, wielding her black blade sword known as [[Netherclaw]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref> A defective [[Herald]] and one of the six beings threatened by the [[Silent King]], she is an [[Overlord Herald]] who possesses a [[void key]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref> While aboard a vessel belonging to [[Redmoon Hall]], the [[Overlady]] intends to strip the organization down to their bones once she learns what she can.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7" /> Having lost her parents to [[Blood Shadows]], she maintains a relationship with a [[Blood Shadow]] that will become [[Ruby]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9">''Dreadgod'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11">''Dreadgod'', chapter 11</ref> As an associate of [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]], she possesses a [[soulspace]] and can translate the squeaks of [[Riverseed]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref> Her body and spirit exist in closer harmony than any other Overlord, and she utilizes [[blood madra]] to facilitate her healing.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Apprentice of Eithan}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|As an apprentice of [[Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius]], Yerin is a [[Riverseed]] capable of fighting [[Dreadgods]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c11" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12">''Dreadgod'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14">''Dreadgod'', chapter 14</ref> She utilizes a [[hunger spears{{!}}hunger spear]] in combat and was passed by the [[Blood Sage]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c14" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref> While hunting [[natural treasures]] from her master's belongings, she pushes for [[advancement]] and displays a crimson [[vital aura]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref> After using a [[void key]] to strike a deal with the [[Remnant]], she fought alongside the [[Blood Sage]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> Yerin possesses scarlet [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]], a red streak of hair, and a [[soul-oath{{!}}soul oath]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> She questioned why the [[Monarchs]] and [[Dreadgods]] were pursuing them, as she is a person who plans to ascend one day.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref> [[Lindon]] felt her [[madra]] while she waited for him at the former site of the [[Heaven’s Glory School{{!}}Heaven's Glory School]], just outside the [[Ancestor's Tomb]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /> Yerin can pluck memories from the air and vanish in a flash of light, once waiting for memory constructs to arrange themselves around her.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref> Located at the entrance to the [[Soulforge]], she possesses six [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]] and one [[Archlord]] blade.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23">''Dreadgod'', chapter 23</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While concerned about [[Mercy]]'s condition, Yerin possesses a [[Heart’s Gem]] and appears beside [[Lindon]] in a flash of [[white light]] with his arm around her.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2">''Waybound'', chapter 2</ref> She was the sole survivor of the test alongside [[Lindon]], and together they are the reason individuals such as [[Mercy]] or [[Little Blue]] might follow them.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref> As [[Reigan Shen]] seeks the removal of [[Lindon]] and Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]], Yerin experiences time dilation relative to [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4">''Waybound'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c6">''Waybound'', chapter 6</ref> Utilizing [[Forged]] [[earth madra]], she has achieved a [[Herald]] state early.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7">''Waybound'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c8">''Waybound'', chapter 8</ref> After sending a message through the [[Dreamway]], Yerin gathers blood and [[sword aura]] in her [[cycling]] room within [[Ghostwind Hall]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref> A character capable of activating [[The Paths of Heaven{{!}}Paths of Heaven]], Yerin expresses jealousy toward [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12" /> Hovering before the [[cloud fortress]], the [[Uncrowned Queen]] uses her [[Divine Treasure]] [[Moonlight Bridge]] and the [[Phoenix Song]] technique.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13">''Waybound'', chapter 13</ref> Yerin flooded her sword with [[madra]] and pursued [[Lindon]], driven by a stubbornness that allows her to push through [[advancement]] realms.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13" /> When [[Lindon]] instructs [[Mercy]] and [[Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel]] to find her, Yerin shines like a crimson star that emits a scarlet fury outshining the sun.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14">''Waybound'', chapter 14</ref> By expanding her spirit into the surrounding [[Blood aura{{!}}blood aura]], she used her blade to kill [[Yushi]] before escaping by cutting through [[Way{{!}}the Way]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c14" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c16">''Waybound'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17">''Waybound'', chapter 17</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Yerin possesses twin [[Remnants]], and her [[Phoenix Song]] has the ability to strip [[madra]], memories, and will from [[Remnants]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20">''Waybound'', chapter 20</ref> As her heart tightens like a bowstring, she travels toward the battle by herself, battling through [[lightning-dragons]] and a hostile storm.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref> After attempting to activate her [[Moonlight Bridge]], she flies at high speed toward the combat area like a silver-and-red comet.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> Driven by an arrogant intent to execute the [[Dreadgod]], she uses her will alone to float and relies on power stolen from a [[Herald]] and a [[Sage]] to sustain herself.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> While the [[Weeping Dragon]] focused its claws and lightning on her, Yerin's [[madra]] proved incompatible with the creature's.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref> Covered in bruises, cuts, and burns, she was eventually wrapped in many bandages.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">21</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Yerin]]'s [[Phoenix Song]] can strip [[Remnants]] of their will, memories, and [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c18" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ghostwind Hall meditation}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|While meditating on the eighth [[Path of Heaven]] in [[Ghostwind Hall]], Yerin possessed eyes that blazed red like [[Fury]]'s.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref> She cycled her [[madra]] to its absolute limit in an effort to remain standing under the weight of [[Malice]]'s [[Authority{{!}}authority]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" /> Her sword blazed with red-and-[[silver madra]] as she utilized a [[Flowing Sword Enforcer technique]] through her [[Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref> Pushing her [[Steelborn body{{!}}Steelborn Iron body]] to its limits, she employed a [[hunger techniques{{!}}hunger technique]] with the goal of making someone a sword artist in five seconds.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27" /> As the [[Death Icon]] raised her to [[Monarch]], Yerin caught [[Mercy]] while remaining restless and focused on working on [[Eithan]]'s attack.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28">''Waybound'', chapter 28</ref> Possessing good insight into the [[advancement]] to [[Herald]], she provided support to [[Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss]] and kept pace with [[Lindon]] as he flew through a gap between the [[Dreadgods]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c28" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29">''Waybound'', chapter 29</ref> After [[Reigan Shen]] used her [[Moonlight Bridge]] to redirect her, Yerin utilized [[black-and-white Striker techniques]] that left cuts carrying echoes of death.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref> Her ascension was not as smooth as [[Fury]]'s, yet she used her [[Goldsign]] to cut a hole in [[Way{{!}}the Way]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31">''Waybound'', chapter 31</ref> Having warned [[Larian]], Yerin was not on the other side of the rift [[Lindon]] opened, leading him to worry that she might have been jailed.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33">''Waybound'', chapter 33</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c36">''Waybound'', chapter 36</ref> She wears black armor.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c37">''Waybound'', chapter 37</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Capable of forging a claw with her [[Blood Shadow]], Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] serves as a protector for the cult of the [[Bleeding Phoenix]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c3">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 3</ref> She is tasked with resolving problems that can be killed and is noted as someone who could have ended the [[Fiend]]'s life quickly.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref> While [[Lindon]] expresses a desire to send her a message and [[Dross]] mentions her name, Yerin has since advanced to the rank of [[Overlady]] [[Herald]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> During a journey through [[Way{{!}}the Way]] with [[Lindon]] and [[Eithan]], she leaned her elbow on [[Lindon]]'s head.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" /> Yerin envisioned her fragment as a place where life could flourish and spread, suggesting the name [[Refuge]] for this world.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" /> After emerging from a [[Way-portal]] accompanied by [[Abidan]] warnings, the [[Death]] [[Monarch]] Yerin [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] visited her birthplace.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 13</ref> Despite having lost her home to [[The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix]], she remarked that the town felt like home.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“He was,” Yerin said, her voice distant.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|“Need to harvest his Remnant,” she said, stretching.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|“He's strong,” she said to Lindon, though even she kept her comment to barely above a whisper.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Behind him, Yerin protested. “He's about as sturdy as a newborn kitten.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|“I’ll admit that’s been my experience,” Yerin allowed, “but my master used to say that no Path is wide enough for two.”<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20" />}}
